import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_home_health_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR HHA 1_CPS_07UHH', header=None)
# Row 22 is Disabled Beneficiaries, row 28 is 2023
# Find the row for Disabled Beneficiaries and then 2023 under it
disabled_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Disabled Beneficiaries', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
year_row = df.iloc[disabled_idx:].loc[df.iloc[disabled_idx:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().isin(['2023', '2023.0'])].iloc[0]
# Total Program Payments is column K (index 10)
result = int(year_row[10])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_home_health_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR HHA 1_CPS_07UHH', header=None)
# Rows 7 to 12 correspond to All Beneficiaries 2018-2023
all_bene_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('All Beneficiaries', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
years_df = df.iloc[all_bene_idx + 1: all_bene_idx + 7].copy()
years_df[0] = years_df[0].astype(str).str.replace(r'\.0$', '', regex=True).str.strip()
years_df[10] = pd.to_numeric(years_df[10])
min_row = years_df.loc[years_df[10].idxmin()]
result = str(min_row[0])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_home_health_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR HHA 3_CPS_07UHH', header=None)
# States run from Alabama (row 9, index 8) to Wyoming (row 59, index 58)
alabama_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Alabama'].index[0]
wyoming_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Wyoming'].index[0]
states_df = df.iloc[alabama_idx: wyoming_idx + 1].copy()
states_df[10] = pd.to_numeric(states_df[10])
top3 = states_df.sort_values(by=10, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].str.strip().tolist()
